title: 第116章 他挺好的第115章 长公主
slug: 大师姐摆烂后带五个道侣飞升了
content_zh:
长公主沉默了一瞬，然后抬脚跟了上去，她走过白婉婉身边的时候没有看她一眼，像是这件事从头到尾都跟她没有关系一样。
白婉婉还站在角落里，看着两个一前一后走出大殿的身影，嘴角那抹弧度又深了一点点，又在门框的阴影即将合拢之前收了回去。
两人一前一后走出大殿，脚步声在门外的石阶上渐行渐远。
沈清辞坐在蒲团上没有动。他的目光从门缝处收回来，落在旁边角落里那个依然低着头的身影上，听不出什么明显的情绪，可那语气里带着一种“我已经等了足够久“的沉静：“这位皇族的长公主，是你带来的吧？“
白婉婉的肩膀微微绷了一下，她抬起头来的时候脸上已经换上了一副带着恰到好处惊讶的表情，睫毛微微颤着，像是被吓了一跳似的张了张嘴，声音又轻又急。
“师尊怎么会这么想？弟子面壁思过这么多天，一步都没有踏出过思过堂——“
“你的灵鸟，“沈清辞打断了她，语气依然平平的，可他的目光正落在她脸上，像是一道慢慢收紧的线，“不是飞出去了吗？“
白婉婉的嘴唇顿了一下，她想要说的下一句话卡在了喉咙里，像是忽然被人按住了后颈的一根筋，让那些准备好的措辞在这一瞬间全都被堵在了齿关后面。
她张了张嘴又闭上，手指在袖子里微微蜷了一下，最终没有再反驳。
沈清辞从蒲团上站了起来，他迈步走下高台的时候步伐不快不慢的，月白色的长袍下摆扫过台阶的边缘，在青石板上铺开一道浅色的弧线。
他走到白婉婉面前停下来，指尖托住了她的下巴，力道不重。
他的目光落在她脸上，从她的眼睛移到她的嘴唇，又移回她的眼睛，声音比方才低了几分，带着一层她之前从未听过的像是冰面下有什么东西正在缓慢融化的音调：“你知道犯了什么错吗？“
白婉婉的下颌在他的指尖微微绷了一下，然后她松开了。
她的睫毛颤了两下，垂下眼又抬起来，目光和他对上的时候她眼底那层方才被戳穿时的慌乱正在缓慢地褪去，像是被什么东西从底层重新铺了一层。
她的手指抬了起来，搭上了他的手臂，指尖顺着那层月白色的袖口布料缓缓地往上滑，落在他的小臂上方，力道又轻又软。
“只要师尊愿意原谅弟子……弟子做什么都可以。“
她说着往前挪了半寸，两人的距离在这半寸之间缩到了只剩下呼吸的交界。
她的目光还落在他脸上，没有移开，像是那扇门被她推开了一条缝之后，她把所有的重量都压在了这一句话上，等着他伸手过来把那扇门推得更开一些。
沈清辞低头看着她，手指还托着她的下巴没有收回来，夜风从门缝里漏进来，把两人之间的烛火吹得晃了一下，在墙壁上投下一道正在缓慢移动的、分不清边界的影子。
另一边的两人穿过山门，沿着通往府邸的山路一前一后地走着。

长公主走在前面半步的位置，步伐带着一种久居高位者特有的从容，可她的嘴没有停，像是在用说话来填补这段路的空白，又像是在刻意让江欲知道她有多了解元梵。
“国师在皇族的时候，从来不用操心任何事。”
“他的卜算之术是整个皇城公认的顶尖，先帝在时对他赞赏有加，我每次去观星台看他，他都是安安静静地坐在那里推演星象，喝的茶是我专门让人从北境采回来的灵茶，穿的是宫里最好的月白色的灵蚕丝袍。“
她的语气带着一种像是在陈述一件极为理所当然的事情的笃定。
“他在皇宫里的时候才是最安心的，你这里——“
她扫了一眼山路边那些正在夜风中轻轻摇晃的灵植，没有把话说完，可那层未尽的意思已经很明确了。
江欲走在后面，安静地听着那些话，没有接腔。
两人走到府邸门口的时候，院门虚掩着，里面透出暖黄色的烛光，在门缝边缘铺开一道细细的光线。
江欲伸手推开了门，木轴转动的时候发出低沉的声响，长公主站在她身后半步的位置，目光越过她的肩膀落进院子里面。
院子中央的石桌边坐着三个人，元梵坐在正中的椅子上，银白色的长发没有像平时那样束起来，而是散落在肩头和椅背边缘，烛光从他侧面的方向照过来，把他银白色的发丝映得泛着一层柔和的暖光。
他的身后站着两个人，沧溟站在他的左侧，手里握着一把木梳正在把他的发尾一点一点地梳开，动作不算太熟练，可他梳的时候很认真，握着梳柄的手指每次落下去之前都会先在发尾处停一下，像是怕扯到他的头发。
谢云开站在另一边，手里端着一碗还在冒着热气的汤药，碗沿搁在元梵手边不远的位置。
元梵靠在椅背上，闭着眼。
他的嘴角弯着一个很浅很浅的弧度，不像是平时面对陌生人时会有的那种带着防备的客套，也不像是从前面对原主时那种带着疏离的冷淡，他自己大概都没有意识到自己的嘴角正在那个位置上。
“你这头发就是要梳整齐了才好看。”
沧溟显然明明知道有人怀了还在据理力争的开口，让元梵相信自己。
长公主站在门口，她的脚步在那个瞬间定住了。
她的目光落在元梵那张脸上，张了张嘴，像是想要叫一声“国师“，可那个称呼到了嘴边的时候她忽然觉得那两个字落在他此刻的状态上有些不太合适。
他正坐在那里，被人梳着头发，身边放着一碗还没喝的汤药，闭着眼，嘴角带着一道不属于任何宫廷礼仪的松弛下来的线条。
江欲这个时候才侧过头来，目光落在长公主那张还带着震惊和没有完全收回去的复杂的脸上。

“他在我这里住得挺好的，你也看到了。“

content_en:
The eldest princess was silent for a moment, and then followed her up. When she walked past Bai Wanwan, she didn't look at her, as if the matter had nothing to do with her from beginning to end.
Bai Wanwan was still standing in the corner, watching the two figures walking out of the hall one after another. The arc at the corner of her mouth deepened a little, and then she retracted it before the shadow of the door frame was about to close.
The two of them walked out of the hall one after another, and the sound of their footsteps gradually faded away on the stone steps outside the door.
Shen Qingci sat on the futon without moving. His eyes retracted from the crack in the door and fell on the figure in the corner with his head still lowered. There was no obvious emotion, but there was a calmness in his tone that said "I have waited long enough": "You brought this eldest princess of the royal family, right?"
Bai Wanwan's shoulders tensed slightly. When she raised her head, her face had already put on a suitably surprised expression. Her eyelashes trembled slightly and she opened her mouth as if she was startled. Her voice was soft and urgent.
"Why would Master think so? This disciple has been thinking about the wall for so many days, and has not even taken a step out of the thinking hall——"
"Your spirit bird," Shen Qingci interrupted her, his tone still calm, but his eyes fell on her face, like a slowly tightening thread, "Didn't it fly out?"
Bai Wanwan's lips paused, and the next words she wanted to say were stuck in her throat, as if someone had suddenly pressed a muscle on the back of her neck, causing all the prepared words to be blocked behind her teeth at this moment.
She opened her mouth and closed it, curled her fingers slightly in her sleeves, and finally did not refute.
Shen Qingci stood up from the futon. When he stepped down the platform, his steps were neither fast nor slow. The hem of his moon-white robe swept over the edge of the steps, spreading a light arc on the bluestone floor.
He walked to Bai Wanwan and stopped, holding her chin with his fingertips without much force.
His eyes fell on her face, moving from her eyes to her lips and back to her eyes. His voice was a little lower than before, with a tone that she had never heard before, like something was slowly melting under the ice: "Do you know what mistake you made?"
Bai Wanwan's chin tensed slightly against his fingertips, and then she let go.
Her eyelashes fluttered twice, she lowered her eyes and raised them again. When her eyes met his, the panic in her eyes when they were pierced was slowly fading away, as if something had re-laid it from the bottom.
She raised her fingers and put them on his arms. Her fingertips slowly slid up along the moon-white cuff fabric and landed on his forearm. The force was light and soft.
"As long as the master is willing to forgive the disciple... the disciple can do anything."
She said and moved forward half an inch, and the distance between the two of them shrank to the point of breathing.
Her eyes were still on his face, and she didn't move away. It was like after she pushed the door open a crack, she put all her weight on this sentence, waiting for him to reach over and push the door open wider.
Shen Qingci looked down at her, his fingers still holding her chin without taking it back. The night wind leaked in through the crack in the door, blowing the candlelight between the two and casting a slow-moving shadow with indistinguishable boundaries on the wall.
The two people on the other side passed through the mountain gate and walked one after another along the mountain road leading to the mansion.
The eldest princess walked half a step ahead, with a calm pace typical of someone who has been in a high position for a long time, but her mouth did not stop, as if she was filling the gap in the road with words, and as if she was deliberately letting Jiang Yu know how much she knew Yuan Fan.
"When the Imperial Master was in the royal family, he never had to worry about anything."
"His divination skills are recognized as the best in the entire imperial city. The late emperor praised him highly when he was still alive. Every time I go to the observatory to see him, he is always sitting there quietly.Deducing the astrology, the tea I drank was the spiritual tea that I had specially brought from the northern border, and I wore the best moon-white spiritual silk robe in the palace. "
Her tone sounded as if she was stating something very natural.
"He feels most at ease when he is in the palace. Here - "
She glanced at the spiritual plants swaying gently in the night wind on the side of the mountain. She didn't finish her sentence, but the unfinished meaning was already very clear.
Jiang Yu walked behind, listening to those words quietly without answering.
When the two of them walked to the door of the mansion, the courtyard door was ajar, and warm yellow candlelight came from inside, spreading a thin line of light around the edge of the door crack.
Jiang Yu reached out and pushed open the door. The wooden shaft made a low sound when it turned. The eldest princess stood half a step behind her, looking over her shoulder into the courtyard.
Three people were sitting at the stone table in the center of the courtyard. Yuan Fan was sitting on a chair in the middle. His long silver-white hair was not tied up as usual, but scattered around his shoulders and the edge of the chair back. The candlelight shone from his side, reflecting his silver-white hair with a soft and warm light.
There were two people standing behind him. Cangming stood on his left side, holding a wooden comb in his hand and combing the ends of his hair bit by bit. His movements were not very skillful, but he was very serious when combing. The fingers holding the handle of the comb would stop at the ends of his hair every time before falling down, as if they were afraid of pulling his hair.
Xie Yunkai stood on the other side, holding a bowl of steaming soup in his hand. The rim of the bowl was placed not far from Yuan Fan's hand.
Yuan Fan leaned back on the chair and closed his eyes.
The corners of his mouth curved in a very shallow arc, not like the defensive politeness he usually had when facing strangers, nor the distant indifference he had when facing the original owner. He himself probably didn't realize that the corners of his mouth were in that position.
"Your hair needs to be neatly combed to look good. "
Cangming obviously knew that someone was pregnant and still argued hard to make Yuanfan believe him.
The eldest princess stood at the door, her steps froze at that moment.
Her eyes fell on Yuan Fan's face, and she opened her mouth, as if she wanted to call him "National Master", but when the title came to her lips, she suddenly felt that those two words were inappropriate for his current state.
He was sitting there, his hair being combed, a bowl of undrinked soup beside him, his eyes closed, and there was a relaxed line at the corner of his mouth that did not belong to any palace etiquette.
Only then did Jiang Yu turn his head, his eyes falling on the eldest princess' complex face that was still filled with shock and not completely retracted.
"He's living well in my place, as you can see. "
